rawRetro.summary: Repaired the internal material library (#506) by porting the issue-475 authorization model (composite resource + data scopes + record-access, permission sets, restriction rule, composite-routes) to the pre-existing materials schema with the content field. Verified end to end against a real SQLite DB and the real standalone runtime: reader sees only P, librarian maintains own rows, sharing D grants view-only, revoke re-evaluates per request, sharing C stays hidden, and disabling the reader kills the existing session while jia is unaffected.

blockers.title: Runtime API acceptance produced misleading 403s from cookie-write CSRF, not authorization
blockers.symptom: PATCH /api/materials/:id returned 403 for both the reader (expected) and the librarian (unexpected), with no authorization debug output; POST /api/users/:id/disable returned 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN.
blockers.rootCause: The authentication plugin rejects cookie-authenticated non-GET requests whose Origin/Referer is absent or untrusted (INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN) before the route/authorization runs. The isolated standalone test harness never set APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, and the ad-hoc requests did not send Origin/Referer.
blockers.resolution: Booted the isolated standalone server with APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost and sent matching Origin + Referer on every write request; all B01-B05 checks then passed. The 403s were a harness artifact, not an application defect.

improvements.title: Isolated standalone test harness does not establish a trusted origin
improvements.detail: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts writeRuntimeTestConfig omits app.publicOrigin, and createIsolatedStandaloneServer sets no APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN, so any cookie-authenticated write test must know to add Origin/Referer or it fails CSRF with a confusing 403.
improvements.suggestedChange: Set app.publicOrigin in writeRuntimeTestConfig (or export APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN from createIsolatedStandaloneServer) so authenticated write requests are trusted by default.

improvements.title: No shared helper for booting the seeded standalone application in feature tests
improvements.detail: createIsolatedStandaloneServer/createInstalledStandaloneServer and requestApp are private to app-server.test.ts. Verifying a feature's endpoints requires duplicating ~120 lines of harness, which discourages runtime tests and caused this repair to rely on a throwaway test file.
improvements.suggestedChange: Export a reusable test helper (e.g. tests/helpers/standalone.ts) that boots the real runtime with migrations and seeds against a temp SQLite database and returns a fetchable server.

evaluation.summary: NocoBase3 的内部资料库授权能力整体成熟：复合资源 + 数据范围/记录范围 + 权限集 + 共享/限制/默认访问三件套 + Repository 策略执行，构成自洽且可组合的声明式模型。verify-4 以真实身份完成 B01–B05 全部通过，证明框架能直接支撑“资料员维护自有、阅读者只读公开非保密、草稿临时共享可撤销、保密资料不可见、停用即失效”。主要问题是环境侧：独立运行时 harness 未设可信来源导致 cookie 写请求被 CSRF 403 掩盖（约 3 次验证成本），以及工厂轮次间工作区被重置使前序实现丢失、连续三次验证面对空壳应用；另有包内 dist 目录与导出子路径不镜像带来的探索成本。

modules.name: 授权模型与复合资源配置
modules.scope: 内部资料库所需的业务动作、字段白名单、记录范围与页面授权建模：复合资源 library.materials（view/create/edit/delete）、defineDatabasePermission、defineRecordAccess（recordsIOwn/published/nonConfidential）、权限集与 seed 配置，以及客户端页面授权。
modules.limitations: 仅评审资料库建模能力；部门/岗位继承、审批流等未涉及。客户端页面的像素级实现未逐页审阅，仅以路由声明与验收截图为准。

requirements.responsibility: 声明业务动作、字段白名单与记录范围，并用权限集绑定岗位角色
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineDatabasePermission 声明集合权限，用 defineRecordAccess 声明 recordsIOwn/published/nonConfidential 记录范围，用 defineCompositeResource 组合业务动作，再用 definePermissionSet + seed 落配置
requirements.actualUsage: resources.ts 声明 publishedAccess/nonConfidentialAccess 与 materials 复合资源；seed-data/permission-sets.ts 定义 librarian/reader 并经 seed 分配 jia/yier

requirements.need: 页面入口与后端动作分开授权（乙能进资料库页但只能读）
requirements.responsibility: 页面授权与业务动作授权分离；页面访问不隐含任何数据动作
requirements.recommendedUsage: 客户端路由声明 authz 页面授权；服务端用复合动作 authorize，授权失败即拒绝并返回策略
requirements.actualUsage: client/routes.ts 给 materials 页面声明 page access；materials.ts 路由对每个端点调用 authorize(composite action)

requirementFit.reason: 声明式模型完整覆盖“甲维护自有、乙只读公开非保密、页面与动作分离”的要求，verify-4 的 B01/B02/B04 均通过。

usability.reason: 动作/字段/范围/权限集分层清晰，seed 可复用同一套 key；但复合资源、page 授权与权限集需要多处共同声明，初学者需读完 Skill 才能拼齐。

agentFriendliness.reason: build() 期校验与明确的类型/错误信息利于自查；dist 子路径与目录不镜像会给路径探索带来成本（见 F7）。

design.reason: 复合资源与数据范围在声明期做一致性校验，动作与范围不可越权组合；权限配置与代码模型解耦，可被设置页管理。

reliability.reason: 注册在 provider boot 完成、迁移/seed 幂等，且模型校验在构建期失败而非运行期静默降级。

modules.name: 共享规则（Sharing Rules）
modules.scope: 管理员把单条草稿 D 临时以只读方式共享给乙、可撤销，且共享不带来编辑权或不相关记录的访问。
modules.limitations: 仅评审单条记录共享；部门范围共享、跨集合 data scope 共享未在本任务出现，未做深入验证。

requirements.need: 管理员把草稿 D 临时只读共享给乙，撤销后乙立即失去访问，且共享不带来编辑权
requirements.responsibility: 共享规则对已持有动作的主体按记录扩展授权（effect=expand），支持按主体与单条记录选择，撤销后下一请求重新求值
requirements.recommendedUsage: 先用权限集给乙 view 动作，再用 Sharing Rules 设置项保存 subjects+scope(view, records([D]))；撤销即删除规则并验证下一请求失去该来源
requirements.actualUsage: 管理员在 Settings > Authorization > Sharing Rules 保存 “Open draft D to reader yier”（View + Specific record D）；B02/B03 通过，应用侧不在代码中固化该例外

requirementFit.reason: 共享语义与“已持有动作 + 记录级扩展 + 可撤销”的需求直接对应，临时共享与撤销均在验收中通过。

usability.reason: 设置页与服务双通道，规则按主体+动作+records 选择表达，撤销只需删除；expand 语义避免把共享误当授权。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确“不授予动作、不能选择全部记录、撤销后下一请求生效”；但 dist 插件目录与导出子路径不一致带来探索成本。

design.reason: 共享作为 expand 约束与默认访问、授权合并，限制随后收窄，语义正交且可组合。

reliability.reason: 规则持久化于数据库存储，请求级重新解析，撤销即失效；规则合并由 constraints 统一处理。

modules.name: 限制规则（Restriction Rules）
modules.scope: 保密资料 C 即使被共享给乙也不可见，且限制不可被授权/共享放大；甲仍可正常读取。
modules.limitations: 仅评审 collection 级只读限制；关系目标继承、写操作限制在本任务未直接使用。

requirements.need: 即使把保密资料 C 共享给乙，乙仍看不到 C；甲可正常读取
requirements.responsibility: 限制规则对匹配主体取交集（effect=restrict），selection 描述仍允许的记录，不授予动作或扩大范围
requirements.recommendedUsage: 为乙注册 nonConfidential 记录范围，在 database.collection 上建 read 限制规则并直接分配给乙；验证增加广泛共享后被排除行仍不可访问
requirements.actualUsage: seed 202609200003 为 yier 建 database.collection 级 read=library.nonConfidential 限制规则并分配给乙；B04 验证共享 C 后乙仍不可见而甲正常

requirementFit.reason: 限制与共享正交，正好实现“共享也不能放大保密内容”。

usability.reason: selection 表达“仍允许”而非“禁止”，并对 collection CRUD 生效；直接分配给用户可在主体关系变化后保留。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确限制不可被共享绕过、并建议直接分配；dist 目录布局仍需探索。

design.reason: expand 先合并、restrict 后取交集，多个来源的语义清晰且可解释。

reliability.reason: 限制通过统一 constraints 管线进入数据库策略，每个请求重新解析。

modules.name: 默认访问（Default Access）
modules.scope: 已发布且非保密的资料对所有持有阅读动作的同事默认可见；默认基线不授予动作并被限制规则收窄。
modules.limitations: 本任务选择用权限集的 published 记录范围表达阅读基线，而非 default-access 插件；对插件本身只做 API 与语义审阅，未做运行时验收。因此分数以可验证的声明/语义为准，略低于直接使用场景。

requirements.need: 已发布且非保密的资料对所有具备阅读资格的同事默认可见（无需逐条共享）
requirements.responsibility: 默认访问为已持有动作的主体增加共享记录基线（effect=expand，每资源一条），且仍受限制规则收窄
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在权限集给 view 绑定 published 记录范围，或用 default-access 规则保存 per-resource 基线；不要复制读默认到写动作
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用 reader 权限集的 view→library.published 实现阅读基线，未使用 default-access 插件；这是等效的合理选择

requirementFit.reason: 需求由 permission set 的记录范围满足且验收通过；default-access 是等效替代路径，本任务未实际启用。

usability.reason: 一条规则即可覆盖所有已持有动作的主体，语义直接；但资源粒度与“不授予动作”的边界需要读到 Skill 才清楚。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确每资源一条规则、重复会被拒绝，可避免误配置；入口分散在 sibling 插件中需按需发现。

design.reason: 默认访问被建模为 expand 约束而非授权，因此与限制求交集后不会让保密资料泄漏。

reliability.reason: 与共享共用统一约束管线，请求级重新解析；插件在未安装时不影响权限集路径。

modules.name: 用户、认证与会话失效
modules.scope: 原生登录/注册/会话与账号管理；管理员停用乙后乙的既有会话立即失效，甲不受影响。
modules.limitations: 仅评审 cookie 会话路径；OAuth、API key、多实例共享缓存未在本任务涉及。CSRF 可信来源属于部署/环境配置，已在需求映射与 finding 中单列。

requirements.need: 停用乙后，乙原有会话无法继续访问；甲的账号和资料不受影响
requirements.responsibility: disable 写入 disabledAt 并删除该用户全部会话，每个请求读取会话时校验 disabledAt
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 userAdministrationServiceToken.disable(userId)（或 UsersService.disable），由插件负责 revokeSessions；不要自建会话表
requirements.actualUsage: 应用保留原生登录与会话，未在业务代码中重实现停用；管理员停用乙后其原会话被重定向登录，甲不受影响（B05）

requirements.need: 保留原生登录/注册/语言切换等既有功能
requirements.responsibility: 认证插件提供 /api/auth/* 与客户端路由，配置通过 defineAuthConfig
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 client/routes.ts 保留 login/register/forgot/reset 路由；在 server/config/auth.ts 用 defineAuthConfig 配置 emailAndPassword 与 session
requirements.actualUsage: client/routes.ts 保留全部原生认证路由；server/config/auth.ts 保留 username+apiKey、emailAndPassword、storeSessionInDatabase

requirements.need: 部署/独立运行时下，带 cookie 的写请求需要可信 Origin/Referer
requirements.responsibility: 认证插件对带 cookie 的非 GET 请求校验可信来源，否则在路由前返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN
requirements.recommendedUsage: 部署时配置 app.publicOrigin 为浏览器可见地址；独立运行时设置 APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN 并发送匹配的 Origin/Referer
requirements.actualUsage: 本次独立验证 harness 未设 APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN，写请求被 403 掩盖，浪费约 3 次验证；设置后 B01–B05 通过

requirementFit.reason: 停用即失效由 disable→revokeSessions + 每请求 disabledAt 校验双重保证，B05 通过且甲不受影响。

usability.reason: 公开接口清晰（disable/enable/revokeSessions），业务侧无需自建会话管理；但 CSRF 403 与授权 403 共用状态码，排障成本高。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 列出接口与部署说明；独立运行时默认不受信来源导致误判，属于环境默认值与指引联动问题。

design.reason: 停用与撤销会话合并为一次服务调用，且每次会话读取都重新校验状态，不依赖客户端。

reliability.reason: 会话存储于数据库并由 regenerate/destroy 删除旧 id，停用即时生效、可审计。

modules.name: 记录范围查询执行（Policy Enforcement）
modules.scope: 授权决策的 conditions.database 绑定到 Repository，使列表/详情只返回允许记录、越权读写被拒；记录范围 resolver 产出可执行过滤 AST。
modules.limitations: 仅评审单集合 Repository 路径；关系目标、聚合与多写事务未在本任务涉及。

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/SKILL.md
entrypoints: Implement in this order 步骤 4（绑定策略）
Enforcement rules（每个读写都要有策略）

requirements.need: 服务端按决策强制记录范围：列表只返回允许行，越权读写被拒
requirements.responsibility: 把授权决策的 conditions.database[collection] 绑定为 Repository policy，查询过滤与 policy scope 取交集
requirements.recommendedUsage: authz.middleware() → 每请求一次 authorize() → repository.withPolicy(conditions.database[collection])；不要重复解析集合授权
requirements.actualUsage: materials.ts 用 decision.conditions?.database?.materials 直接 withPolicy(...) 执行 findMany/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne，越权在 SQL 层被过滤

requirements.need: 记录范围 resolver 返回可执行的过滤 AST（owner/published/confidential）
requirements.responsibility: record access resolver 返回 repository-input 过滤 AST；policy scope 只允许本集合直接字段，拒绝关系路径与 JSON 操作符
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 defineRecordAccess resolver 中用 buildFilter(...) 构建条件；避免关系路径与 $json 操作符
requirements.actualUsage: resources.ts 的 published/nonConfidential resolver 用 buildFilter(...) 构建条件，经 conditions.database 传给仓储

requirementFit.reason: 记录范围在 SQL 层强制，B01–B04 的读者可见性与越权拒绝均通过。

usability.reason: 决策对象可直接交给 withPolicy，无需手写 SQL；narrow() 支持在同一请求内收窄策略。

agentFriendliness.reason: normalize 期的明确错误（INVALID_POLICY/POLICY_REQUIRED）利于自查；conditions.database 的结构需要从授权 Skill/参考中了解。

design.reason: 策略在 Repository 层统一执行，多个 scope 以 AND 合并；字段名/操作符在规范化阶段校验，防止绕过。

reliability.reason: 策略随请求绑定并每次从决策派生，无跨请求持久化；规范化深拷贝/冻结 AST，避免状态污染。

findings.title: 声明式授权模型完整，覆盖动作、字段与记录范围
findings.detail: 复合资源 + 数据范围 + 记录范围 + 权限集形成完整闭环：动作与范围在构建期校验，字段可白名单，记录范围以稳定 key 复用；资料库的甲/乙权限边界无需自建 ACL。
findings.impact: 框架能直接表达岗位职责与自有/公开/保密记录范围，减少手写权限中间件。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现有 builder 语义与校验，继续用一条命令同步 Skill。

findings.title: 记录范围决策可直接绑定 Repository 并在 SQL 层生效
findings.detail: authorize() 返回的 conditions.database[collection] 可直接交给 withPolicy()，policy scope 与查询条件取交集；应用路由无需手写过滤，读者越权读写由数据库层拒绝。
findings.impact: 授权与查询执行解耦但强绑定，降低遗漏范围过滤的风险。
findings.suggestedChange: 在授权 Skill 中继续强调“一次 authorize、直接 withPolicy、勿重复解析”。

findings.title: 共享（expand）与限制（restrict）语义正交，可安全组合
findings.detail: 共享与默认访问都是 expand 且不授予动作，限制是 restrict 且只收窄；约束在统一管线按 effect 合并，因此“临时共享草稿”与“保密不可见”可同时成立。
findings.impact: 协作例外与合规排除互不干扰，管理员可临时开放再撤销而不扩大权限。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持约束合并顺序（先 expand 后 restrict）并在文档中显式声明。

findings.title: 停用账号即撤销会话，且每次请求重新校验
findings.detail: UserAdministrationService.disable() 写入 disabledAt 并删除该用户全部会话；会话读取时再校验 disabledAt，因此旧 cookie 在被停用后立即失效，而其它账号不受影响。
findings.impact: 无需自建会话表即可满足“停用即失效”的安全要求。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持 disable/revokeSessions 的原子语义并在 Skill 中提示不要绕过服务层。

findings.title: 独立运行时 harness 未建立可信来源，cookie 写请求被 CSRF 403 掩盖
findings.detail: 认证插件在路由/授权之前拒绝缺少可信 Origin/Referer 的 cookie 写请求（INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN）。本任务的独立运行时验证 harness 未设置 APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN，导致 PATCH/停用接口对合法身份也返回 403，需额外的 Origin/Referer 才能继续，浪费约 3 次验证；retro 已将其标为 resolved 并建议在 writeRuntimeTestConfig 设置 app.publicOrigin。
findings.impact: 验证阶段误把环境问题当成授权失败，若不是 agent 自行定位，可能得出“框架不支持写操作”的错误结论。
findings.suggestedChange: 让 createIsolatedStandaloneServer / writeRuntimeTestConfig 默认注入 app.publicOrigin 与匹配 trustedOrigins，或提供可复用的 standalone 测试助手。

diagnosis.trigger: 在未设置可信来源的独立运行时上用带 cookie 的请求执行写操作
diagnosis.expected: 写请求返回真实的授权结果（200 或授权 403）
diagnosis.actual: 认证插件在路由前返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN，掩盖了授权结论
diagnosis.workaround: 以 APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN 启动运行时并发送匹配的 Origin/Referer
diagnosis.acceptance: isolated standalone harness 默认设置 app.publicOrigin/可信来源后，cookie 写请求不再因 CSRF 失败

findings.title: 轮次之间工作区被重置，前序实现丢失导致连续验证面对空壳应用
findings.detail: agent-implement、repair-1、repair-2 的产物没有在轮次间保留：repair-3 开场 git status 仅有迁移文件，verify-1/verify-2/verify-3 面对的是空的默认 NocoBase 壳，B01–B05 全部 failed；repair-3 因此重做了全部 17 个文件。retro.json 未记录这次工作丢失。
findings.impact: 三次验证失败并非框架或业务实现缺陷，而是工厂工作区持久化问题；这会浪费预算并可能被误判为框架能力不足。
findings.suggestedChange: 确保修复轮次在同一工作区上进行并保留上一轮改动；在 process/retro 中记录工作区重置与环境重建事件。

diagnosis.trigger: 修复轮次开始前工作区被重置到基线提交
diagnosis.expected: 上一轮的实现保留，验证针对当前实现状态
diagnosis.actual: 仅迁移文件幸存，verify-1/2/3 面对空壳应用并全部失败，repair-3 重做全部产物
diagnosis.workaround: 在单轮内完成并自测全部实现（repair-3 实际采用）

evidence.observation: defineCompositeResource 用一个 builder 声明业务动作；build()/校验强制动作唯一、动作至少授予一项、data scope 键唯一、且同一 data scope 只能指向一个目标 collection。
authorizationPlugin 的 middleware 把 `authz: for({principal, subjects})` 放到请求上；for(identity) 组装 grants 与 constraints，authorizeWithGrants 在不解析记录范围时也能判定动作级 allow/deny。
defineRecordAccess + RecordAccessRegistry：记录范围以稳定 key 注册，resolver 负责把选择解析为可执行过滤 AST，供数据库授权与规则插件复用。
RuleService.constraints() 把每个适用规则输出为 {source, effect, selection}：expand（共享/默认访问）先合并、restrict（限制）取交集，因此限制不可被共享放大。
sharingRulesPlugin 用 effect `expand` 声明共享规则：只对已持有动作的主体补充所选记录，不授予动作。
restrictionRulesPlugin 用 effect `restrict` 声明限制规则：selection 描述“仍允许的记录”，对匹配主体的决策取交集。
defaultAccessPlugin 用 effect `expand` 且 onePerResource 声明默认基线：对已持有动作的主体统一扩大可见记录，不授予动作或字段。
definePermissionSet(key) 构建可移植的权限集定义（纯数据），可在安装 seed 中与声明共用同一动作/范围 key，无需运行中的应用。
数据库授权把检查结果解释成 conditions.database：每个 collection 一项策略，记录范围选择会得到 SELECTION_EXPANDED / SELECTION_RESTRICTED 等可诊断说明，无记录范围则 NO_RECORD_ACCESS。
defineDatabasePermission(collection) 链式声明 action/字段/记录范围：options()、default()（仅在有记录范围时缺省）、read()/create()/update()/delete() 各自绑定 recordAccess 或选择。
databasePlugin 注册 database.collection 目录类型，并用 composeConditions 把多项检查折叠为 conditions.database 策略。
sharingRules() 配置工厂：依赖 settings/database/ui，注册 DatabaseSharingRuleStore 与 read/create/update/delete 四个设置动作，供管理员在 Settings > Authorization > Sharing Rules 维护规则。
restrictionRules() 配置工厂：依赖 settings/database/ui，注册限制规则存储与设置动作。
defaultAccess() 配置工厂：依赖 settings/database/ui，注册默认访问规则存储与设置动作。
UsersService.disable() 在事务内校验主体可被移除并写入停用状态；用户写操作集中在服务层，业务代码无需自建停用逻辑。
UserAdministrationService.disable() 设置 disabledAt=new Date() 并立即 await revokeSessions(userId)，enable() 清空 disabledAt；revokeSessions 直接删除该用户的会话记录。停用与撤销会话是一次原子操作。
会话读取时校验 user.disabledAt != null 即视为未登录（第114-117行），并对带 cookie 的非 GET 请求校验 Origin/Referer 是否为可信源，否则返回 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN。
RequestSession.regenerate()/destroy() 会从存储中删除旧会话 id，因此撤销会话后旧 cookie 立即失效。
Repository.withPolicy(policy) 把授权的 conditions.database 策略绑定到仓储；已绑定策略的仓储不可重绑（INVALID_POLICY），须用 narrow() 收窄。查询在 SQL 层应用该策略。
combinePolicyFilter 把仓储策略的多个 scope 过滤条件以 AND 合并，保证限制与授权选择同时生效。
normalizeReadNode 校验范围为集合直接字段，允许嵌套 and/or，拒绝关系路径与 JSON 操作符，避免记录范围被绕过或被误用。
buildFilter 把声明式过滤条件编译为仓储查询可执行的 AST，供记录范围 resolver 与仓储输入复用。
授权 Skill 给出实现顺序（迁移→defineDatabasePermission/defineCompositeResource→provider boot 注册→路由 authorize→客户端 authz 路由→权限配置→验证）与强制规则（authorize 拒绝 deny 或缺策略；每个读写都要绑定策略；不建第二套字段权限）。
evidence.excerpt:
1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.database.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from the database; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require` needs an unconditional permit and rejects conditional decisions. Business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial or missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving collection grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the Repository route definition and bind each method to its composite action with `authz.database.authorizeRepository`. Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions need custom handlers. `authz.database.policyFor` folds collection grants; without its third argument it does not respect a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.

evidence.observation: 共享 Skill 明确：共享为已持有动作的主体增加所选记录，不授予动作/字段/页面；先经权限集授予动作再保存规则；撤销后下一个请求只失去该来源；共享不能激活缺失的操作。
evidence.excerpt:
A sharing rule adds selected records, or a record access selection, for the subjects it lists, provided they already hold the action. Sharing does not grant the operation, fields, page access or related records, and it cannot select all records. Grants, default access and sharing combine first; restriction rules then narrow the result.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For sharing between departments, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. A rule whose recipient is a department shares specific records with it; a viewer-relative department scope such as 本部门及下属部门 is computed for the viewer and cannot select another department's records. The guide's optional sharing section covers this plugin, and its core section says what remains with permission sets alone.

## Development workflow

1. Identify the real collaboration exception: who receives which records, for which actions, and why. Use explicit records for one handover; use a record access selection for a maintained region or team rule.
2. Grant the recipients the business action through a permission set first. Register inherited subjects and their active membership resolver through the main authorization Skill.
3. Inspect every data scope the operation requires. Quote submission needs the selected quote and its actual parent project. Add each action and data scope deliberately; view, edit and submit are different permissions.
4. Save a complete rule through the settings page or the service. Keep record ids tied to their data scope's collection and preserve the other entries on update.
5. Verify the handover works, an unshared parent still blocks the workflow, restrictions still exclude confidential records, and sharing alone cannot activate a missing operation.
6. Revoke the recipient or the team's permission set and verify the next request loses only that source. Independent direct-user sharing and direct assignments must survive.

For example, a quote handover shares quote edit and submit plus the parent project's submit scope with a delegated engineer. Use the real record ids, never sample ones.

evidence.excerpt:
A restriction rule intersects the records an action reaches with the rule's selection, for the subjects it lists. The selection describes the records still allowed, not the records to hide. Several matching restrictions all apply; none can grant an action or widen a range.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-restriction-rules/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For a restriction assigned to a department, or to the root department for the whole company, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. Its core works with permission sets alone and says how to keep excluded records out without this plugin; its optional restriction section covers this one.

## Development workflow

1. State the invariant positively, for example "this team may access only non-confidential projects". Define who it applies to and whether it covers one operation or every path to a collection.
2. Use a rule on a composite, with `scopeKey`, for an operation-specific limit. For a limit across every business branch, create a rule on the `database.collection` with its CRUD actions; the settings page offers declared business data scopes, and collection-wide invariants can be provisioned through the service.
3. Register a suitable record access and save the complete rule. Apply the restriction directly to a user as well when it must remain after that person's team membership is removed.
4. Bind policies on all protected reads and writes. For relation targets, declare relation record access explicitly; a standalone collection restriction is not inherited by nested relation writes.
5. Verify the excluded row stays inaccessible after adding broad sharing and another permission set, across each protected operation, and that unrelated actors keep their intended access.

For example, a confidentiality restriction assigned directly to each account holds whichever permission set grants the action. Test with ordinary users: unrestricted identities skip every rule.

evidence.observation: 默认访问 Skill 明确：默认访问为已持有动作的身份增加共享记录基线，不授予动作/页面/字段；每个资源只能有一条规则，重复会被拒绝；限制仍会移除被排除的行。
evidence.excerpt:
Default access adds a shared record baseline for every identity that already holds an action. It does not grant the action, page access or additional fields. A baseline combines with permission-set data scopes and sharing, and restriction rules still narrow the result, so choose it as an intentional minimum range rather than a fallback for identities without a scope of their own.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-default-access/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For a department-scoped baseline, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. Its core works with permission sets alone, and its optional default-access section explains why a global default suits a department scope only when everyone holding the action belongs to a department.

## Development workflow

1. Identify which records every holder of a particular operation should receive by default. A read baseline can be broad while edit remains preparer-only; do not copy read defaults into write operations.
2. Confirm the composite, action and data scope exist and that the scope's grants target the intended collection. Reuse an applicable record access or define one through the main authorization Skill.
3. Save one rule per resource under a stable `key`; a second rule on the same resource is rejected, so extend the existing rule instead. A rule lists every action and data scope it widens; updating it replaces the whole rule, and deleting it removes the baseline, not the permission-set action.
4. Verify a holder receives the baseline, a person without the action remains denied, and restrictions still remove excluded rows. Also verify an explicit narrow data scope is not unexpectedly broadened by a permissive default.

For example, a quote view baseline can follow related-project ownership while editing follows the preparer, and a job's permission set can separately grant broad viewing that confidentiality restrictions narrow. A project's owner is not necessarily the author of every quote on that project.

evidence.excerpt:
Server, from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` (the root entry is the
server entry) or `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/server`:

- `authenticationToken` resolves the `Auth` instance: `required()`,
  `optional()`, `getSession(headers)`, `handler(request)`.
- `AuthEnv` types a Hono router whose routes read `context.get('auth')`.
- `userAdministrationServiceToken` resolves `UserAdministrationService`:
  `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `resetPassword`,
  `revokeSessions`, `withConnection`; errors are `UserAdministrationError`.
- `AuthConfig` is Better Auth's `BetterAuthOptions`, the type of the application's `server/config/auth.ts`. User initialization configuration lives separately under `users.initialAdmin`.
- `createAuthentication`, `databaseAdapter`, `createAuthStorage` build an
  instance outside the application runtime, mainly in tests.

evidence.observation: 认证参考说明 app.publicOrigin 应设为浏览器可见的 HTTPS 地址，且 Auth.required()/optional() 会拒绝缺少可信 Origin/Referer 的带 cookie 写请求（业务请求 CSRF）。
evidence.excerpt:
**Public origin.** Set `app.publicOrigin` to the HTTPS address the browser
sees. Better Auth derives its base URL and callback URLs from it and from the
application's public base path; a container-internal address breaks OAuth
callbacks and cookie attributes. The reverse proxy must forward host,
protocol, and cookies.

**Business request CSRF.** `Auth.required()` and `Auth.optional()` reject cookie-bearing writes unless `Origin` (or, when absent, `Referer`) matches Better Auth's configured base origin or a trusted origin. Configure `app.publicOrigin` for deployed applications and add separate frontend origins through `auth.trustedOrigins`; without a trusted origin, browser writes fail closed with `INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN`. Cookie-free API key requests can proceed after authentication. A credential header does not exempt a request carrying cookies, including routes that skip session lookup.

const materialDelete = defineDatabasePermission((permission) =>
  permission
    .collection<Material>(MATERIALS_COLLECTION)
    .title(titleOfCollection)
    .read(READ_FIELDS)
    .delete()
    .options(recordAccess.recordsIOwn)
    .default(recordAccess.recordsIOwn),

/**
 * The library's business operations: viewing, creating, editing and deleting materials.
 *
 * Every writer action also composes reading, so the record a write returns is authorized by the same decision, while
 * each action still exposes only the fields and operation it performs — a viewer grant can never be widened into a
 * writer one. Admin-created sharing rules target `view` alone, so a temporary share of a draft grants reading and
 * nothing more.
 */
export const materials = defineCompositeResource(
  'library.materials',
  (resource) =>
    resource
      .title(title('library.title'))
      .action('view', (action) =>
        action
          .title(title('library.action.view'))
          .grant(MATERIALS_SCOPE, materialView),
      )
      .action('create', (action) =>
        action
          .title(title('library.action.create'))
          .grant(MATERIALS_SCOPE, materialCreate),
      )
      .action('edit', (action) =>
        action
          .title(title('library.action.edit'))
          .grant(MATERIALS_SCOPE, materialEdit),
      )
      .action('delete', (action) =>
        action
          .title(title('library.action.delete'))
          .grant(MATERIALS_SCOPE, materialDelete),
      ),
);
